invariants: Public registration never creates SECURITY or ADMIN users.
An internal invitation is role-bound, expires in 24 hours, is one-time, and is persisted only as a salted derived value.
Only an active ADMIN can issue invitations or change account state.
The currently logged-in administrator and the final active administrator cannot be disabled.
Passwords are never persisted in plaintext.
residualRisks: Local-only identity and authorization cannot provide server-side trust.
The invitation plaintext must be distributed through a controlled out-of-band channel.
Device compromise can defeat application-level controls.
nextControl: Replace local identity issuance with a campus-managed server identity provider before production deployment.
